Hi Samantha — Laura from Finance here. Thanks for confirming your VAT number. A couple of specifics so AP can process cleanly: 

1) VAT treatment: because Acme is a UK VAT-registered business and this is a B2B supply of software/inference services, we will issue a corrected invoice showing 0% VAT with a note "reverse charge — UK customer to account for VAT". Please confirm the exact VAT number you want printed (we'll use GB999999973 unless you advise otherwise). If you prefer Redwood to charge VAT, tell us and we will reissue at 20%.

2) Intermediary/correspondent bank routing: if you instruct the GBP account above (Barclays GB), your bank should route GBP directly and no correspondent is used. If your bank chooses to route via a non-GBP/US bridge, the intermediary SWIFT that sometimes appears is CHASGB2L (JP Morgan London) or CITIUS33 (Citibank NYC) depending on the rails. To prevent deductions please: instruct "BEN" for beneficiary charges + "OUR" for sender charges where your bank supports it, and add the invoice number in the payment reference.

3) Shortfall handling: if we receive less than the gross invoice value due to deductions, Redwood will bill the shortfall to Acme and payment terms for that shortfall are the same as original invoice (30 days). We can also accept a separate reimbursement payment if you prefer to split.

4) Remittance: please email treasury@redwoodinference.com with the payment details (amount, value date, trace/reference) once scheduled so we can match.

If you want, Michael from Payments (cc'd) can jump on a 10–15 minute call with your bank to confirm routing and set the correct instruction codes to avoid deductions.

Thanks —
